We are hiring!

We've got exciting projects underway, more data challenges to solve and a growing team of brilliant people making it all happen.

And now, we're looking for new people to join us. 👀

Who are we? We are the data people. We help organisations make data-driven decisions they can trust.

But great data work isn't just about the technology. It's about the people behind it, the knowledge they bring and what we can achieve together.

We'll be sharing more about the opportunities very soon. So, follow us here and keep your eyes peeled 💚

And if you're interested in what we're building at Binary10, give us a follow. 
There's plenty more to come!
comment: As data teams grow, maintaining consistent definitions and ownership becomes harder than scaling the technology. Clear accountability early on can make the difference between trusted insights and conflicting numbers.
